title: Memoria y justicia
goal: Read how these countries tried, imperfectly and unevenly, to reckon with the past -- Argentina's Punto Final and Obediencia Debida amnesty laws and their annulment, and memory sites like the former ESMA.
grammar: A día de hoy: hablar de la situación actual

items: Explain the dilemma societies faced between punishing the guilty and accepting impunity.
Describe what the Punto Final and Obediencia Debida laws did.
Explain what happened after the amnesty laws were annulled.
Describe what the former ESMA became.
Use a día de hoy to anchor a claim in the present.
